title: Reset state on prop change: key, not Effect

slides.say: Switch to another user’s profile and the unsent comment stays. You want it cleared.
Resetting in an Effect renders first with the stale comment, then again. And every nested component with state would need the same Effect.
Instead, split the component and pass user id as a key to the inner one. A new key means a new profile, so all state below resets automatically.

slides.text: Callers still pass userId. The key stays an inner detail.
slides.say: Callers of Profile Page just pass user id. Using it as a key is an implementation detail.
